Villa overview

Located in the exclusive Nueva Andalucía, a five minute drive from Puerto Banus city centre, as well as to beaches and recreational areas.
This newly renovated villa is built to the highest standard. When entering this remarkable villa you will appreciate the quality that just oozes through the property.
The villa has four double size bedrooms and one family bedroom with two separate beds. It is located just four hundred meters from the famous Los Naranjos Golf Club, and nine hundred meters from La Quinta Golf Club. It has four bathrooms and separate guest w.c. The Villais just two kilometers from the marina and beaches of Puerto Banus.
The villa can comfortably accommodate up to twelve people.

There are fantastic relaxing areas both inside and outside. There is a large lounge and dining area on the ground floor, which also houses the thoroughly modern kitchen with all the expected modern appliances. Downstairs has the bar area and access to the pool and games area, which has the large Jacuzzi. The pool can be heated if required in spring or autumn. Outside offers both dining and relaxation areas. The owners have put a small putting green, so all of the golf enthusiasts can practice their putting, you can also play table tennis and there is boules pitch, so lots to keep everybody busy.

All the bedrooms are spacious with plenty of wardrobe space; the master enjoys a walk in dressing room.

This is the perfect villa for a great family vacation in probably one of the most popular locations, certainly in Spain and quite possible the whole of Europe!

For those who love to walk you can get to both Puerto Banus and Marbella from the Paseo along the Golden Mile. Once there you can visit The Old Town, which is the city centre, it’s full of history and charm, this part of the city cannot be missed. Another must see is the famous Orange Square. Both Marbella & Puerto Banus offer everything in the way of bars, restaurants and night clubs. You will find many reasons to come back again and again, the little bars and shops, the ancient roman wall , the narrow cobbled streets and colourful balconies and of course the locals, really friendly and open people.

The villa is located a short distance from the bull-ring of Puerto Banus and Centro Plaza where you can find shops, restaurants, banks and supermarket. The Marbella Casino and the beach are also only a short distance. Puerto Banus is where you can find the most exclusive shops and restaurants on the Costa del Sol, cinemas and shopping centres like El Corte Ingles or Marina Banus.

This fantastic villa is in the perfect position to explore the delights of the Costa del Sol and Southern Spain, or just relax and enjoy the fantastic micro climate!! The historic towns of Ronda, Cordoba, Granada, Seville, Cadiz and Gibraltar can be seen on day trips, although an overnight stay is recommended in Seville and Cadiz.

SIERRA NEVADA is a fantastic holiday experience for the whole family!! The ski paradise is not just for skiers, but attractive for the whole family regardless of age and fitness. Sierra Nevada is just a two hour drive from Marbella. You can drive there and back in one day. Sierra Nevada normally closes the first weekend in May.
